Db.description: The decibel of q!(-3 dB): a gain of 10^(x/20) for a ratio of root-power quantities, 10^(x/10) for one of powers.

Np.description: The neper of q!(-0.5 Np): a gain of e^x for a ratio of root-power quantities, e^(2x) for one of powers.

AboveStandardAtmosphere.description: Pressure above one standard atmosphere, 101325 Pa (ISO 2533): gauge pressure with its reference stated, so it converts to Vacuum at compile time.

AbsoluteZero.description: Thermodynamic temperature, from absolute zero: Point<AbsoluteZero, Fixed<Kelvin, Milli, u32>> is a temperature in mK.

Celsius.description: Degrees Celsius: 0 °C is 273.15 K, a degree is 1 K (SI Brochure 2.3.4).

DeviceBoot.description: A device's boot, the zero of its monotonic clock, on DeviceMonotonic.

Gauge.description: Gauge pressure, from the ambient pressure (a tyre, a compressor): converts to Vacuum only with the ambient pressure at run time (Point::against), never at compile time.

GpsEpoch.description: The GPS epoch, 1980-01-06 00:00:00 GPS time, which is 1980-01-06 00:00:19 TAI: GPS time counts every SI second and stays 19 s behind TAI, so it is an origin on TaiScale, 694 656 019 s after TaiEpoch1958 (8040 days and 19 s).

NtpEpoch.description: NTP's epoch, 1900-01-01 00:00:00 UTC, on PosixScale: 2 208 988 800 s before the UnixEpoch, exactly (NTP counts every day as 86400 s too, RFC 5905).

PtpEpoch.description: PTP's epoch (IEEE 1588), 1970-01-01 00:00:00 TAI, on TaiScale: 378 691 200 s (4383 days) after TaiEpoch1958.

Rankine.description: Degrees Rankine: from absolute zero, a degree is 5/9 K (NIST SP 811 B.8).

UnixEpoch.description: The Unix epoch, 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC, on PosixScale: a point from it is a moment in POSIX time, as CLOCK_REALTIME, time_t, journald's __REALTIME_TIMESTAMP and most log formats count it.

Absorbance.description: Absorbance A = −lg T of a transmitted power ratio T, AU ((ln 10)/2 NeperLoss, exactly): the loss in bels of power, so 1 AU is 10 dB.

Acceleration.description: Acceleration in meters per second squared, m/s².

AngularAcceleration.description: Angular acceleration in radians per second squared, rad/s² (rad·s⁻²).

AngularMomentum.description: Angular momentum in kilogram square meters per second, kg·m²/s, counted as joule seconds per radian (kg·m²·s⁻¹·rad⁻¹), like Torque: a MomentOfInertia times an AngularVelocity, and a Torque times a Second.

AngularVelocity.description: Angular velocity in radians per second, rad/s (rad·s⁻¹): not a Hertz, a turn is 2π rad.

Area.description: Area in square meters, m² (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 5).

Barn.description: Area in barns, b (10⁻²⁸ m², SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 8): a nuclear cross section.

BarrelFermentedLiquor.description: Barrel (US federal fermented liquor tax, 31 gal): 31 gal.

BarrelLiquidState.description: Barrel for liquids (US state laws, 31.5 gal): 31.5 gal.

BarrelProofSpirits.description: Barrel (US federal proof spirits, 40 gal): 40 gal.

Baud.description: Symbol rate in baud, Bd (s⁻¹): one symbol per second, for a UART one bit per second on the line.

Becquerel.description: Radioactivity in becquerels, Bq (s⁻¹), an Activity: not a frequency in Hertz.

Bel.description: A level in bels, B ((ln 10)/2 Neper, 10 Decibel), the unit the decibel is a tenth of (IEC 80000-3).

Bit.description: Information in bits, bit: the base of information, so a size never mixes with a Ratio or a count of things.

Block.description: A count of blocks, block: of a block device, whose size differs per device (bytes through Per<Byte, Block>).

Btu39f.description: British thermal unit (39 °F): measured: water at 39 °F.

Btu59f.description: British thermal unit (59 °F): measured: water at 59 °F.

Btu60f.description: British thermal unit (60 °F): measured: water at 60 °F.

BtuIt.description: British thermal unit (International Table): 1.055 055 852 62 kJ; cal_IT/(g·°C) · lb · °F.

Byte.description: Information in bytes, B (8 Bit): a data size, a buffer's capacity, an offset.

CentimetreMegahertz.description: Length times frequency in centimetre-megahertz, cm·MHz (10⁴ m·Hz, the dimension of a speed): medical ultrasound's own unit for frequency-scaled attenuation, α(f) = α₀·f, so Per<Loss<Decibel>, CentimetreMegahertz> prints as a datasheet writes it, "dB/(cm·MHz)" (soft tissue ≈ 0.5), the middle dot parenthesizing the denominator as a rad/s one already does.

Char.description: A count of characters, char: of a UART line (an idle time in characters).

ChargeDensity.description: Electric charge density in coulombs per cubic meter, C/m³ (m⁻³·s·A, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6).

Chunk.description: A count of chunks, chunk: of a transfer or a file format (bytes through Per<Byte, Chunk>).

CircularMil.description: Circular mil: area of a circle 1 mil across, π/4 mil².

Code.description: A count of raw codes of a converter, code: an ADC's or DAC's output before scaling (LSB).

Conductivity.description: Electrical conductivity in siemens per meter, S/m (kg⁻¹·m⁻³·s³·A²): seawater is about 5 S/m.

CoulombPerKilogram.description: Exposure to X and γ rays in coulombs per kilogram, C/kg (kg⁻¹·s·A, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6), an Exposure: not a specific charge, though both are C/kg.

Curie.description: Activity in curies, Ci (3.7·10¹⁰ Bq exactly; 12th CGPM, 1964, Resolution 7; SI Brochure, 9th ed., appendix 1), an Activity: not a frequency in Hertz.

CurrentDensity.description: Current density in amperes per square meter, A/m² (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 5): a trace's or a wire's A/mm² is Fixed<CurrentDensity, Mega, T>.

Cycle.description: A count of cycles, cycle: clock cycles, time quanta; time only with a clock (Per<Cycle, Second>).

Dalton.description: The dalton (unified atomic mass unit), Da, 1 Da = 1 u = m_u: one twelfth of a ¹²C atom's mass (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 8, note). m_u is measured (NUM-32), so its scale keeps the symbol, and a value comes only from a named set of constants, convert_with.

Day.description: Time in days, d (86400 Second), a unit accepted for use with the SI (SI Brochure table 8): always 86400 s, also across a leap second, so a UTC calendar day with one is 1 d + 1 s.

Decibel.description: A level in decibels, dB ((ln 10)/20 Neper, exactly): 20·lg of a root-power ratio, 10·lg of a power ratio, the same number for both.

DecibelLoss.description: A loss in decibels, dB ((ln 10)/20 NeperLoss, exactly): a cable's 17.7 dB/100 m is Per<Loss<Decibel>, _> of +17.7.

Degree.description: Angle in degrees of arc, ° (π/180 rad, exactly: an exact Magnitude).

Density.description: Density, mass density or mass concentration in kilograms per cubic meter, kg/m³ (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 5); g/L is the same unit.

Doubleword.description: Information in 64-bit doublewords, doubleword (8 Byte): Arm's doubleword, the program width of an STM32G0's or L4's flash, a 64-bit DMA or bus transfer.

DynamicViscosity.description: Dynamic viscosity in pascal seconds, Pa·s (kg·m⁻¹·s⁻¹, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6): water at 20 °C is about 1 mPa·s.

ElectricDisplacement.description: Electric displacement (electric flux density) or surface charge density in coulombs per square meter, C/m² (m⁻²·s·A, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6).

ElectricFieldStrength.description: Electric field strength in volts per meter, V/m (kg·m·s⁻³·A⁻¹, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6).

ElectronVolt.description: Energy in electron-volts, eV: 1.602176634·10⁻¹⁹ J exactly, the elementary charge times a volt (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 8; exact since the 2019 SI fixed e).

Entry.description: A count of entries, entry: of a log, a list, a directory, a table of contents.

Feet100.description: Length in hundreds of feet (international foot), 100 ft = 30.48 m: a cable datasheet's own unit, so Per<Loss<Decibel>, Feet100> reads as it prints, "dB/100 ft".

FootOfMercuryConventional.description: Foot of mercury (conventional): 1 ft · 13 595.1 kg/m³ · g_n.

FootOfWater39f.description: Foot of water (39.2 °F): measured: water density at 39.2 °F.

FootOfWaterConventional.description: Foot of water (conventional): 1 ft · 1000 kg/m³ · g_n.

Frame.description: A count of frames, frame (a bus's, a video's).

Gram.description: Mass in grams, g (10⁻³ kg): 5 kg is Gram::kilo(5u8).

GramPerCubicCentimeter.description: Density in grams per cubic centimetre, g/cm³ (10³ kg/m³, also kg/L): water is about 1 g/cm³.

GramPerMole.description: Molar mass in grams per mole, g/mol (10⁻³ kg/mol): water is about 18.015 g/mol.

Gray.description: Absorbed dose in grays, Gy (m²·s⁻², J/kg), an AbsorbedDose: not a dose in Sievert, which weights it by the radiation, and not a kerma, which the SI also gives the gray (Kerma, Of<Kerma, Gray>).

GrayPerSecond.description: Absorbed dose rate in grays per second, Gy/s (m²·s⁻³, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6), an AbsorbedDoseRate: not a dose equivalent rate in SievertPerHour.

GregorianYear.description: The Gregorian calendar year, "a (Gregorian)" (365.2425 d, 31 556 952 s exactly): the civil calendar's mean year over its 400-year leap cycle, apart from the astronomical JulianYear and NUBASE2020's TropicalYearNubase2020. q! takes it only as a type or a quoted string, q!(5 "a (Gregorian)"): the symbol's own stem, "a", is JulianYear's too, so q! refuses it bare.

Halfword.description: Information in 16-bit halfwords, halfword (2 Byte): Arm's halfword, a 16-bit register, bus or DMA transfer.

HeatCapacity.description: Heat capacity in joules per kelvin, J/K (kg·m²·s⁻²·K⁻¹, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6).

HeatFluxDensity.description: Heat flux density in watts per square meter, W/m² (kg·s⁻³, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6): heat through a surface.

HeatTransferCoefficient.description: Heat transfer coefficient in watts per square meter kelvin, W/(m²·K) (kg·s⁻³·K⁻¹): convection from a surface.

Hertz.description: Frequency in hertz, Hz (s⁻¹), a Frequency: not an activity in Becquerel.

HertzPerSecond.description: Frequency drift in hertz per second, Hz/s (s⁻²).

HorsepowerBoiler.description: Horsepower (boiler): evaporation rate of water; no exact definition fits SP 811's value.

Hour.description: Time in hours, h (3600 Second), a unit accepted for use with the SI (SI Brochure table 8).

InchOfMercury32f.description: Inch of mercury (32 °F): measured: mercury density at 32 °F.

InchOfMercury60f.description: Inch of mercury (60 °F): measured: mercury density at 60 °F.

InchOfMercuryConventional.description: Inch of mercury (conventional): 1 in · 13 595.1 kg/m³ · g_n.

InchOfWater39f.description: Inch of water (39.2 °F): measured: water density at 39.2 °F.

InchOfWater60f.description: Inch of water (60 °F): measured: water density at 60 °F.

InchOfWaterConventional.description: Inch of water (conventional): 1 in · 1000 kg/m³ · g_n.

Irradiance.description: Irradiance in watts per square meter, W/m² (kg·s⁻³, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6): sunlight on a solar panel, about 1000 W/m² at noon.

Item.description: A count of things, item: a queue's length, a number of filters, channels, presses, repeats, steps.

Jerk.description: Jerk in meters per second cubed, m/s³.

Joule.description: Energy, work or heat in joules, J (kg·m²·s⁻², N·m, W·s).

JulianYear.description: The Julian year, a (365.25 d, 31 557 600 s exactly; IAU): the astronomical year, what "a", "ka", "Ma" and "Ga" mean in the literature.

KiloElectronVoltPerMicrometer.description: Linear energy transfer in kiloelectronvolts per micrometre, keV/µm (1.602176634·10⁻¹⁰ J/m exactly), a LinearEnergyTransfer, not a force: the L of the quality factor Q(L) (radiation).

Kilometre.description: Length in kilometers, km: a fibre's own unit, so Per<Loss<Decibel>, Kilometre> reads as it prints, "dB/km" (0.2 dB/km at 1550 nm is typical).

KinematicViscosity.description: Kinematic viscosity, or a diffusivity, in square meters per second, m²/s: a dynamic viscosity over a density.

Line.description: A count of lines, line: of a text, a file, a log.

Ln10.description: The number ln 10 as a unit, dimensionless: the same as Ln2 for a natural log of ten, as in a level in nepers from one in bels.

Ln2.description: The number ln 2 as a unit, dimensionless: Exact<Ln2>::int(3) is exactly 3·ln 2.

Lumen.description: Luminous flux in lumens, lm (cd·sr, cd·rad²).

LuminousEfficacy.description: Luminous efficacy in lumens per watt, lm/W (cd·rad²·kg⁻¹·m⁻²·s³): an LED's light per electrical watt.

MagneticFieldStrength.description: Magnetic field strength in amperes per meter, A/m (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 5).

MassFlow.description: Mass flow rate in kilograms per second, kg/s.

Metres100.description: Length in hundreds of meters, 100 m: a cable datasheet's own unit, so Per<Loss<Decibel>, Metres100> reads as it prints, "dB/100 m".

MillimetreOfMercuryConventional.description: Millimetre of mercury (conventional): 1 mm · 13 595.1 kg/m³ · g_n.

MillimetreOfMercuryEu.description: Millimetre of mercury (EU legal, blood pressure): 133.322 Pa.

MillimetreOfWaterConventional.description: Millimetre of water (conventional): 1 mm · 1000 kg/m³ · g_n.

Minute.description: Time in minutes, min (60 Second), a unit accepted for use with the SI (SI Brochure table 8).

Molality.description: Molality in moles per kilogram of solvent, mol/kg.

MolarCentimeter.description: A concentration times a path length in molar centimeters, M·cm (10 mol/m²): what a molar absorptivity is per, Per<Absorbance, MolarCentimeter> printing AU/(M·cm), the L/(mol·cm) of tables.

MolarConcentration.description: Amount concentration (molarity) in moles per cubic meter, mol/m³ (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 5); a mol/L is MolePerLitre, 10³ mol/m³.

MolarEnergy.description: Molar energy in joules per mole, J/mol (kg·m²·s⁻²·mol⁻¹, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6).

MolarHeatCapacity.description: Molar heat capacity in joules per mole kelvin, J/(mol·K) (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6): the gas constant R is 8.314..

MolarMass.description: Molar mass in kilograms per mole, kg/mol; the g/mol of tables is GramPerMole.

Mole.description: Amount of substance in moles, mol.

MolePerLitre.description: Amount concentration in moles per litre, mol/L (10³ mol/m³): the chemist's molar, M.

MomentOfInertia.description: Moment of inertia in kilogram square meters, kg·m², counted per square radian (kg·m²·rad⁻²): times an AngularAcceleration it is a Torque, and ½·I·ω² is a Joule.

Momentum.description: Momentum or impulse in kilogram meters per second, kg·m/s (N·s).

NauticalMileUsPre1954.description: Nautical mile (US, before 1 Jul 1954): 1853.248 m (≈ 6080.20 ft).

Neper.description: A level in nepers, Np: ln(F/F₀) of a root-power quantity, ½·ln(P/P₀) of a power, so a field level and its power level are the same number (ISO 80000-3, IEC 60027-3).

NeperLoss.description: A loss in nepers, Np: a Neper level signed as a loss, positive for a decay, as attenuation coefficients and datasheets write it.

Newton.description: Force or weight in newtons, N (kg·m·s⁻²).

Nibble.description: Information in nibbles, nibble (4 Bit): a hex digit, a BCD digit, a 4-bit field.

Nit.description: Luminance in candelas per square meter, cd/m² (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 5), the nit: a display's brightness.

Ohm.description: Resistance, reactance or impedance in ohms, Ω (kg·m²·s⁻³·A⁻², V/A).

OpticalDepth.description: Optical depth τ = −ln T of a transmitted power ratio T, τ (½ NeperLoss, exactly): power falls as e^(−τ), its field as e^(−τ/2), so 1 Np of loss is 2 of depth. τ = ln 10 · A of an Absorbance, a conversion by name for integers.

Pascal.description: Pressure or stress in pascals, Pa (kg·m⁻¹·s⁻², N/m²).

Permeability.description: Permeability in henries per meter, H/m (kg·m·s⁻²·A⁻², SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6); also a cable's inductance per length.

Permittivity.description: Permittivity in farads per meter, F/m (kg⁻¹·m⁻³·s⁴·A², SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6); also a cable's capacitance per length.

PowerDensity.description: Power density, or a volumetric heat source, in watts per cubic meter, W/m³ (kg·m⁻¹·s⁻³).

Rad.description: Absorbed dose in rads, rd (0.01 Gy; NIST SP 811, Appendix B; NIST HB 44, Appendix C), an AbsorbedDose: the symbol is "rd", not "rad", which is the radian's (Radian). customary's rod, RodInternational, shares "rd": with both features on, q! refuses the symbol, naming both.

Radian.description: Angle in radians, rad: a base dimension of its own here, so an angle doesn't mix with a Ratio.

Radiance.description: Radiance in watts per square meter steradian, W/(m²·sr) (kg·s⁻³·rad⁻², SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6).

RadiantIntensity.description: Radiant intensity in watts per steradian, W/sr (kg·m²·s⁻³·rad⁻², SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6): an IR LED's.

Ratio.description: A fraction: a duty cycle, a probability, a scale factor, an efficiency (dimensionless, 1). 0.5 is half, not a level in decibels.

Record.description: A count of records, record: of a store, a file format, a ring buffer.

Rem.description: Dose equivalent in rems, rem (0.01 Sv; NIST SP 811, Appendix B; NIST HB 44, Appendix C): the SI's dose equivalent H = Q·D, a bare Sievert's quantity, DoseEquivalent, not ICRP's EquivalentDose or EffectiveDose.

Resistivity.description: Electrical resistivity in ohm meters, Ω·m (kg·m³·s⁻³·A⁻²): copper is about 17 nΩ·m.

RodInternational.description: Rod, pole or perch (international foot): 16.5 ft.

Roentgen.description: Exposure in röntgens, R (2.58·10⁻⁴ C/kg exactly, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 8), an Exposure: not an absorbed dose or a dose equivalent, though all three were once confused.

Row.description: A count of rows, row: of a table, a grid, a report.

Sample.description: A count of samples, sample: an ADC's, a logic analyzer's; a sample rate is Per<Sample, Second>.

Sector.description: A count of sectors, sector: of a flash or a disk (bytes through Per<Byte, Sector>).

Siemens.description: Admittance, conductance or susceptance in siemens, S (kg⁻¹·m⁻²·s³·A², A/V).

Sievert.description: Dose equivalent in sieverts, Sv (m²·s⁻², J/kg): the SI's DoseEquivalent, H = Q·D (CIPM 2002, Recommendation 2).

SievertPerHour.description: Dose equivalent rate in sieverts per hour, Sv/h (1/3600 Sv/s), a DoseEquivalentRate: a dosimeter's µSv/h is Fixed<SievertPerHour, Micro, T>.

Snap.description: Snap or jounce in meters per second to the fourth, m/s⁴.

SpecificHeatCapacity.description: Specific heat capacity in joules per kilogram kelvin, J/(kg·K) (m²·s⁻²·K⁻¹, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6): water is about 4186 J/(kg·K).

SpecificVolume.description: Specific volume in cubic meters per kilogram, m³/kg (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 5).

Speed.description: Speed in meters per second, m/s.

Stop.description: A level in stops ((ln 2)/2 Neper, exactly): log2 of a power ratio, the factor of 2 in light of photography, 2·log2 of a root-power one.

SurfaceDensity.description: Surface density, mass per area, in kilograms per square meter, kg/m² (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 5): a paper's grammage in g/m² is Fixed<SurfaceDensity, Milli, T>.

SurfaceTension.description: Surface tension in newtons per meter, N/m (kg·s⁻², SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6); also a spring's stiffness.

Tesla.description: Magnetic flux density in teslas, T (kg·s⁻²·A⁻¹, Wb/m²).

ThermalConductance.description: Thermal conductance in watts per kelvin, W/K (kg·m²·s⁻³·K⁻¹): the inverse of a ThermalResistance.

ThermalConductivity.description: Thermal conductivity in watts per meter kelvin, W/(m·K) (kg·m·s⁻³·K⁻¹, SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 6): a thermal pad's datasheet value.

ThermalResistance.description: Thermal resistance in kelvins per watt, K/W (kg⁻¹·m⁻²·s³·K): a heatsink's, a package's θJA.

TonOfTnt.description: Ton of TNT (energy equivalent): 10⁹ cal_th = 4.184 GJ.

TonWater.description: Water ton (English, 224 imperial gal): 224 imperial gal.

Torque.description: Torque or moment of force in newton-meters, N·m, counted as joules per radian (kg·m²·s⁻²·rad⁻¹): not the dimension of a Joule, and a torque times an AngularVelocity is a Watt.

TropicalYearNubase2020.description: NUBASE2020's year, "y (NUBASE2020)" (365.2422 d, 31 556 926.08 s; Kondev et al., Chinese Phys.

Turn.description: Angle in turns (revolutions), rev (2π rad, exactly).

Var.description: Reactive power in volt-amperes reactive, var (kg·m²·s⁻³, like Watt): Im(S), ISO 80000-6's Q, of the complex power S = V·I*.

Volt.description: Voltage, electric potential or electromotive force in volts, V (kg·m²·s⁻³·A⁻¹, W/A).

VoltAmpere.description: Apparent power in volt-amperes, VA (kg·m²·s⁻³, like Watt): |S|, ISO 80000-6's S, of the complex power S = V·I*.

Volume.description: Volume in cubic meters, m³ (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 5); a litre is Litre, 10⁻³ m³.

VolumetricFlow.description: Volumetric flow in cubic meters per second, m³/s.

Watt.description: Power in watts, W (kg·m²·s⁻³, J/s, V·A): active power, P, of ISO 80000-6 (Power, next to the two below).

Wavenumber.description: Wavenumber in reciprocal meters, m⁻¹ (SI Brochure, 9th ed., table 5): the cm⁻¹ of spectroscopy is Fixed<Wavenumber, Hecto, T>, 100 m⁻¹.

Weber.description: Magnetic flux in webers, Wb (kg·m²·s⁻²·A⁻¹, V·s).

Week.description: Time in weeks, wk (7 Day, 604800 Second): a retention or a report period.

Word.description: Information in 32-bit words, word (4 Byte): flash and RAM sizes of a 32-bit MCU.

Yank.description: Yank, the rate of change of force, in newtons per second, N/s (kg·m·s⁻³).
